name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood summers spent watching Formula 1 races with her grandfather. A natural aptitude for mathematics and physics led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating with honors, she joined a small Austrian racing team, honing her skills in data analysis and car setup.

Her reputation for meticulousness and innovative problem-solving quickly grew, attracting the attention of larger teams. Klara believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking marginal gains through rigorous testing and simulation. She is known for her ability to translate complex technical information into actionable instructions for the driver, fostering a strong working relationship built on trust and mutual respect. Her distinctive approach involves adapting strategies on the fly, taking into account the smallest of factors.

Klara's time at Walkinshaw Andretti United has seen both triumph and challenge. She pushes those around her to be their best, sometimes to a fault.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A slender woman with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workstation, even at the track.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
